title: 월급 관리하기: 모으고, 쓰고, 불리기
objective: By the end, you can use ten words about income, saving, and investing, along with the verbs they usually go with (대출을 받다, 손해를 보다, 적금을 들다), in short sentences about your own money.
summary: Learn ten key words for talking about income, spending, saving, loans, and investing in everyday Korean life.

task.title: Use the money words
task.line: Choose, fill in, or judge each sentence using the words and verb pairs from page 1.

words.meaning: income (money you earn from work or business)
words.exampleMeaning: Freelancers earn a different income every month.

words.example: 이번 달은 병원비 때문에 지출이 많았어요.
words.exampleMeaning: My spending was high this month because of hospital bills.

words.meaning: to save (by using less), to cut back on
words.example: 전기를 절약하려고 안 쓰는 플러그는 뽑아 둬요.
words.exampleMeaning: I unplug things I'm not using to save electricity.

words.meaning: to put money aside, to save money
words.exampleMeaning: When I get paid, I put a little aside first.

words.meaning: installment savings account (you add money every month); 적금을 들다 = to open one
words.exampleMeaning: I opened a one-year savings plan so I can move next year.

words.meaning: interest (extra money paid on savings or a loan)
words.example: 통장에 돈을 넣어 둬도 이자가 거의 안 붙어요.
words.exampleMeaning: Even if I keep money in the account, it earns almost no interest.

words.meaning: loan from a bank; 대출을 받다 = to take out a loan
words.exampleMeaning: I took out a bank loan to buy a house.

words.example: 남는 돈을 조금 투자해 볼까 해요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'm thinking of investing some of my spare money.

words.example: 요즘 주식 시장이 안 좋아서 걱정이에요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'm worried because the stock market is bad these days.

words.meaning: loss (of money); 손해를 보다 = to lose money
words.exampleMeaning: I lost money because I sold in a hurry.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 이번 달에는 외식을 줄여서 생활비를 (절약했어요 / 투자했어요). ② 노후를 위해 매달 조금씩 (저축해요 / 지출해요).
Fill in the blank with the verb that goes with the noun, in the -았/었어요 form: ① 차를 사려고 은행에서 대출을 ____. ② 집값이 떨어질 때 팔아서 손해를 ____. ③ 여름에 여행을 가려고 6개월짜리 적금을 ____.
Write the word from the word list that matches each meaning: ① 일을 해서 번 돈 ② 생활하면서 쓴 돈 ③ 돈을 맡기거나 빌릴 때 원래 금액에 더 붙는 돈
Read each sentence and write Yes (true) or No (false): ① 지출이 소득보다 많으면 저축하기 쉬워요. ② 대출을 받으면 보통 이자를 내야 해요. ③ 주식에 투자하면 손해를 볼 수도 있어요.
Answer in one or two Korean sentences: 돈이 조금 생기면 저축하고 싶어요, 아니면 투자하고 싶어요? 왜요?
answers: ① 받았어요 ② 봤어요 ③ 들었어요
① 소득 ② 지출 ③ 이자
① No ② Yes ③ Yes
Sample answer: 저는 저축하고 싶어요. 주식에 투자하면 손해를 볼 수도 있어서 걱정돼요. (Other answers are fine if they use the words correctly, e.g. 저는 투자하고 싶어요. 은행 이자가 너무 낮아서요.)
